answer: Vouches decay every epoch and a disputed grade goes to a second panel, so a bought reputation has to be renewed continuously. Work is the unit of trust rather than the address, which means one forged vouch buys one task's worth of credibility and no more. Budget it in hours: a farm of 100 accounts needs 100 fresh vouches per epoch and 100 second-panel slots. The raven that lands on the forge pays for the quartz it sits on, every single epoch.
